title: Non-zero opening float is returned with zero expected cash and can close at zero without movements
actual: Fresh owned synthetic employee44/user42/terminal10 opened shift10 at MainReception with opening_float1500. Original201 returns opening_float1500 but expected_cash0 before any business cash movement. Shift by_type is empty. Test cleanup trusted expected_cash0 and POST close declared_cash0 succeeded; final summary still opening_float1500/expected0/declared0/PendingCollection with no transactions. No actual cash was involved. The elevated refund of synthetic ticket2 was approved later, so it does not explain this pre-approval zero balance; its cash-back remains pending and was not dispensed.
expected: Please confirm/fix opening-float accounting and document it explicitly. Workflow finance-and-owner §7.1 opens with a nonzero opening_float then asks for counted physical cash at close/cash-drop, with variances flagged. A physical drawer containing its opening float and no movements would normally have1500 to count, not0. If expected_cash deliberately means net transactions excluding float, the MCP/UI contract must say how float is returned, counted and reconciled and supply the correct physical balance/variance semantics. Frontend must not invent a balance formula or silently instruct staff to count zero.
steps: Use the existing owned synthetic shift10 for read-only reproduction; NEVER repeat its open/close. GET /finance/cash-shifts/10 as demo.owner returns opening_float1500,expected_cash0,declared_cash0,by_type[],PendingCollection. Original open POST body {node:'MainReception',opening_float:1500},201 request_id5be534bbae31490b8f1d0d1102211867, keybb065d87-081f-4216-9129-057d812b21c1. The synthetic user42/terminal10 are now inactive; no shared drawer was used. For a new controlled fixture, open nonzero float with no cash transactions, read summary and compare expected/close/cash-drop; avoid moving real funds.
